parameters.help_en: The name of the studio. The name can be up to 50 characters in length and cannot contain single quotation marks, semicolons, less than signs, greater than signs, equal signs, vertical lines, or parentheses
parameters.help_zh: 工作室名称。最长 50 个字符，不能包含英文单引号、分号、小于号、大于号、等号、竖线和圆括号
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of users allowed in the studio team. Valid values: 2 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 工作室团队允许的用户数量上限，取值范围为 2 至 1000
parameters.name: user_count_limit

schema.description_en: The response returned when the request is successful
schema.description_zh: 请求成功时的返回结果

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the default project generated through automatic creation when the studio is created
ProjectId.description_zh: 创建工作室时自动创建的默认项目 ID

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求
